headline: Why TransDigm (TDG) Shares Are Sliding Today
summary: Shares of aerospace and defense company TransDigm (NYSE:TDG) fell 10.4% in the afternoon session after the company reported mixed fourth quarter earnings with organic revenue falling short of expectations. Overall, this was a decent quarter. The stock's reaction suggests the market was expecting more.
